class.name: HTMLInputElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML input element.
class.description: Returned by queries and [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<input>[/code]. [HTMLLabel] supports text, search, tel, url, email, password, number, range, date, month, week, time, datetime-local, color, file, checkbox, radio, button, submit, reset, image, and hidden. Text and picker values are tracked separately from the markup default. Checkbox and radio values default to [code]on[/code]. A selected file contributes a read-only [HTMLInputFile] to form data. Script assignments emit no user editing signals.

method.name: get_files
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the selected files. Returns an empty array for other input types.

method.name: get_validity
method.description: Returns the boolean flags [code]will_validate[/code], [code]valid[/code], [code]value_missing[/code], [code]type_mismatch[/code], [code]bad_input[/code], [code]pattern_mismatch[/code], [code]range_underflow[/code], [code]range_overflow[/code], [code]step_mismatch[/code], [code]too_short[/code], and [code]too_long[/code]. The [code]pattern[/code] attribute uses Godot's [RegEx] syntax and matches the full value. ECMAScript Unicode Sets syntax may differ.

method.name: get_value_as_date
method.description: Returns [code]year[/code], [code]month[/code], [code]day[/code], [code]hour[/code], [code]minute[/code], [code]second[/code], and [code]millisecond[/code]. A month starts on its first day, a week starts on Monday, and a time uses the date 1970-01-01. Returns an empty dictionary when the value is empty or this operation does not apply, including for datetime-local.

method.name: set_value_as_date
method.description: Sets the input from date or time parts. An empty dictionary clears the value. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for input types without a date getter and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for invalid parts.

method.name: show_picker
method.description: Opens the input picker or suggestions in the owning [HTMLLabel]. The element must be visible, connected, mutable, and within the active dialog if one is modal.

method.name: step_up
method.description: Increases a numeric or temporal value using its configured step and limits. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when stepping does not apply or [code]step="any"[/code].

method.name: step_down
method.description: Decreases a numeric or temporal value using its configured step and limits.

method.name: get_selection_end
method.description: Returns the end of the single-line text selection. Other input types and invalid handles return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_selection_start
method.description: Returns the start of the single-line text selection. Other input types and invalid handles return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: set_selection_range
method.description: Sets the single-line selection using Godot string character indices. Indices snap to grapheme boundaries. Equal indices set the caret.

members.member: The current input value. For a file input, this is an empty string or the first selected file name with the standard fake-path prefix. Only an empty assignment can change a file input's value.
The current checked state. Before a script or user sets it, the state follows the [code]checked[/code] attribute.
The mixed state of a checkbox. It changes the appearance and is cleared by user activation. Form data uses [member checked].

The numeric value, or NaN when unavailable. Months count from January 1970, times use milliseconds since midnight, and other temporal values use milliseconds from the civil epoch without applying a timezone offset.
